feeds.title: All Things Target
feeds.description: Christy has been blogging about Target for over 12 years and shopping there for...well, let's just say a lot longer than that! She loves helping others score the best clearance deals, redeem the most exciting Circle offers, and find the latest 'must-have' items. All Things Target is a website that shares coupons, clearance deals and more all centered around your favorite store...TARGET!

feeds.title: Target Addict Blog
feeds.description: Some people are addicted to love. Others are addicted to drugs. I'm addicted to Target. Knows where all the local Target stores are (there are at least 6 within driving distance) and shops there at least twice a week.

feeds.description: From corporate responsibility to jobs, you can expect more from Target. Our mission is to make Target the preferred shopping destination for our guests by delivering outstanding value, continuous innovation and exceptional guest experience by consistently fulfilling our Expect More.
